title: Accessibility and Gorenstein injective envelopes
summary: Let $\mathcal{G}$ be a Grothendieck category. We prove completeness of the Gorenstein injective cotorsion pair whenever $\mathcal{G}$ admits a set of Tate trivial generators, and show that having such generators is necessary for completeness. In this case it must be a perfect cotorsion pair, cogenerated by a set, and equivalent to an injective abelian model structure on $\mathcal{G}$.
